BEFORE YOU ENABLE LIVE

Review what gets shared

Live reads new messages in local Codex Desktop chats. To identify a topic, it sends a short excerpt and the local feed’s stored project names and tasks to Codex after best-effort redaction. Redaction can miss sensitive details; project IDs are sent unchanged. Browser-only project edits are not included.

Live may miss the first message in a newly discovered chat and messages written while a chat file is changing. If a chat file is rewritten in place, older text, including messages sent while paused, may be read after Live is enabled.

You can review, edit, or cancel the proposed search phrase before a separate search-enabled Codex invocation receives it. That invocation may send the phrase or queries derived from it to search providers. The excerpt and stored project details have already been sent to Codex by that point.
REVIEW BEFORE SEARCH

Check the search phrase

A short, best-effort-redacted chat excerpt and stored project names and tasks were already sent to Codex to suggest this phrase, along with unchanged project IDs. If approved, a separate search-enabled Codex invocation receives the phrase below and may send it or queries derived from it to search providers. Remove any private details before continuing.

Review the project assignment and details. Approving will create the new project or replace the selected project’s stored name and task if videos are found.

THE EARLY VERSION

Built around your work

When live mode is on, the local YourTube service listens for new user messages in local Codex Desktop chats. Short excerpts and the local feed’s stored project names and tasks are sent to Codex to infer your current work. Redaction is best effort and can miss sensitive details; project IDs are sent unchanged. Browser-only edits do not change these stored details. Separately, you can edit, approve, or cancel the proposed search phrase before a search-enabled Codex invocation receives it. That invocation may send the phrase or queries derived from it to search providers. YouTube verifies video titles and creators. Recommendations can still be irrelevant or inaccurate.

Live may miss the first message in a newly discovered chat or messages written while a chat file is changing. A chat file rewritten in place may cause older text, including text written while paused, to be read after Live is enabled.

Choose a project, edit or delete its context, save videos for later, and add your own links. Your changes live in this browser. YouTube thumbnail requests happen as the feed loads; playback connects to YouTube when you choose a video.

YourTube doesn't block the rest of YouTube. You can edit or remove a project here. Use the Live button above to pause or resume chat reading. Live starts paused each time the service restarts. The connection works only while the local YourTube service is running.
